proposals.title: Item 4. Shareholder Proposal Regarding Charitable Giving Reporting
proposals.proponent: The National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the company list recipients of corporate charitable contributions of $5,000 or more on the company website, plus restrictions and monitoring of contributions.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD UNANIMOUSLY RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL.
